chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, Muḥammad ibn Muslim, and Burayd ibn Muʿāwiyah al-ʿIjlī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh and Abī Jaʿfar, peace be upon them, concerning:
A beast, a mouse, a dog, or a bird falls into the well and dies. He said: “It is taken out, then buckets are drawn from the well, then drink and perform wudu (ablution).”

key_terms.الدَّابَّةُ: a beast or animal that falls into the well
key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well in which impurity has occurred
key_terms.يُخْرَجُ: it is removed from the well

ai.seo_question: What should be done if an animal falls into a well and dies in it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a well into which an animal falls and dies. It states that the dead animal should be removed, then some buckets of water should be drawn out, after which the water may be used for drinking and wudu (ablution).
